One of the best Indian restaurants in Da Nang
Sep 2026 • Solo
Punjabi Haveli has a new chef, and I think I just had the Best Vindaloo I’ve ever had!

Service:
- Every time I’ve visited, Jordan, Raman and Prince have been very welcoming, friendly, professional & accommodating.
- I always ask for my curries to have no salt and not to be oily and every time the chef cooks me a perfect curry.
- Rating: 5/5

Atmosphere:
- Nice background music
- Good lighting
- Comfortable Chairs
- To go to toilet, you need to go outside and next door. It’s clean and has tissue.
- Rating: 5/5

Comment:
It would be great if you installed a TV, so you could play some Bollywood Music Videos.

* Chicken Bhuna:(Medium Spice)

Good choice
Sep 2025 • Couples
We had a great experience at Haveli in Da Nang. The service was attentive and friendly, and the food didn’t disappoint. We ordered the chicken tikka masala, bhuna chicken, and garlic naan—so good we ended up ordering the naan twice. Do note that rice is ordered separately, which is common in many Indian restaurants. Prices were reasonable for the quality and portion size. Overall, a solid choice if you’re craving Indian food in Da Nang.
